definition_hindi: औपचारिक व्याकरणिक चिह्नांकन या संबंधात्मक संरचना के स्थान पर शाब्दिक अर्थवस्तु, भाषा-बाह्य अर्थ अथवा संप्रेषणात्मक धारणाओं द्वारा परिभाषित या नियंत्रित।

etymology.historical_development: Formed from notion + -al (Latin -ālis). Specialized grammatical usage was established by Otto Jespersen in 1928 (verified in Etymonline). Primary verification of D. A. Wilkins's 1976 language-pedagogy coinage (notional syllabus) in an opened source is Not yet established.

register_and_pragmatics.academic_register: High scholarly linguistic and lexicographic Tatsama register
register_and_pragmatics.connotation: Neutral-semantic; anchors grammatical classification in speaker meaning and mental referent conception rather than surface syntax
cultural_nuances: Hindi splits English notional sharply by discipline: linguistic senses require concept/meaning-anchored Tatsama forms (धारणात्मक, अभिप्रायात्मक, बोधात्मक) completely separate from financial कल्पित or service-law नोशनल.
usage_restrictions: Do not use सैद्धांतिक for notional agreement/concord, because सैद्धांतिक सहमति denotes 'agreement in principle' rather than semantic verb agreement.
Do not confuse notional with notational (संकेतन रीति / सांकेतिक).
Avoid काल्पनिक, नोशनल, and आनुमानिक in grammar and applied linguistics.
Reject Hindwi's unattested typographical corruption अभियात्मक and Shabdkosh's erroneous fault-finding gloss छिद्रान्वेषी.
Do not use भाववाचक for notional: it is the grammatical term for abstract noun.

linguistic_analysis.morphosyntax: English notional acts as a non-gradable classifying modifier in S4, appearing both attributively (notional agreement) and predicatively (a verb is notional vs. relational). Hindi धारणात्मक (धारणा + आत्मक via vowel sandhi), अभिप्रायात्मक, and बोधात्मक are invariable Sanskrit Tatsama adjectives whose gender and number agreement fall strictly on the modified head noun.
linguistic_analysis.lexical_collision: Shabdkosh lists भाववाचक, which collides with standard Hindi grammatical terminology for abstract nouns (भाववाचक संज्ञा).

conceptual_analysis.core_distinction: Contrasts meaning-driven, lexical, or referent-based grammatical rules (such as notional concord/synesis and lexical notional verbs) against purely formal, morphological, or relational syntactic rules.
conceptual_analysis.domain_boundary: Distinct from S1 philosophical abstraction, S2 administrative paper progression, S3 financial/tax reference bases, S5 whimsical temperament, and S6 espionage front companies.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both are formal Tatsama adjectives used in academic Hindi.
pairwise_comparison.difference: धारणात्मक anchors grammatical concord in the speaker's mental conception of referent number/meaning, whereas सैद्धांतिक denotes doctrine or principle (सिद्धांत संबंधी); rendering notional agreement as सैद्धांतिक सहमति misfires as 'agreement in principle'.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Not interchangeable in linguistics and grammar.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both foreground semantic intent or mental content over formal syntactic structure.
pairwise_comparison.difference: अभिप्रायात्मक is directly attested in opened Shabdkosh for notional and highlights intended purport (अभिप्राय), whereas धारणात्मक maps directly to notion (धारणा) though its direct linguistic attestation in opened Hindi texts is Not yet established. The suggestion that Hindwi's अभियात्मक is a misprint of अभिप्रायात्मक is unverified.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: High in semantic-grammatical contexts; both require verification in primary Hindi linguistics textbooks.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both are formed via -आत्मक from Sanskrit concept nouns (धारणा and अवधारणा).
pairwise_comparison.difference: अवधारणात्मक is directly attested in opened IGNOU logic coursework for conceptual analysis (अवधारणात्मक विश्लेषण), whereas धारणात्मक aligns with lexicographic 'Abstract Notion — अमूर्त धारणा' in opened Hindi Wiktionary.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Moderate in general semantics; prefer अवधारणात्मक in philosophy/logic and धारणात्मक in notional grammar.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Minimal; only adjacent through English orthographic confusion between notional and notational.
pairwise_comparison.difference: सांकेतिक corresponds to symbolic/notational or nominal, not meaning-based grammatical categories.

proposed_terminology.justification: Existing Sanskrit-derived Hindi adjectives धारणात्मक, अभिप्रायात्मक, and बोधात्मक already cover S4 morphologically; primary-source verification in CSTT and university linguistics textbooks is required rather than coining a new term.
